content: The session on emerging tuberculosis (TB) policy development needs, within the context of the current evidence landscape and existing gaps, is scheduled from 15:50 to 16:00. This will be followed by a summary and discussion on the way forward, chaired by Tereza Kasaeva. Annex 2: List of Participants 1.
